description: This file defines a React Native package class `Fido2ApiPackage` that implements `ReactPackage`. It provides methods to create view managers and register native modules, specifically registering `Fido2ApiModule`.

classes.name: Fido2ApiPackage
classes.description: A React Native package implementation providing native modules and view managers, specifically for Fido2 API integration.

methods.name: createViewManagers
methods.description: Returns an empty list of ViewManager instances, indicating no custom view managers provided by this package.

methods.name: createNativeModules
methods.description: Creates and returns a list of native modules, adding an instance of Fido2ApiModule to the list.
